cases.about: The newest dump restores into a scratch database; orders fell 27% on last week, so it is flagged first; today's counts are carried forward.

shell.output:
dump /backups/pg/shop-2026-10-25.dump 2026-10-25 03:00:12 412M
restore exit 0
count public.orders 9100
count public.customers 3215
took 94s

call.command: f=/backups/pg; [ -d "$f" ] && f=$(ls -t "$f"/* | head -1); echo "dump $f $(date -r "$f" '+%F %T') $(du -h "$f" | cut -f1)"; t=$(mktemp -d); s=$(date +%s); PATH=$(ls -d /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin 2>/dev/null | tail -1):$PATH; initdb -D "$t/db" -A trust -U drill >/dev/null && pg_ctl -D "$t/db" -o "-k $t -c listen_addresses=''" -l "$t/log" -w start >/dev/null && createdb -h "$t" -U drill drill && (case "$f" in *.sql|*.sql.gz) zcat -f "$f" | psql -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h "$t" -U drill drill;; *) pg_restore --no-owner -h "$t" -U drill -d drill "$f";; esac) 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "restore exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; psql -h "$t" -U drill -At drill -c "select schemaname||'.'||tablename from pg_tables where schemaname not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema')" | while read x; do echo "count $x $(psql -h "$t" -U drill -At drill -c "select count(*) from $x")"; done; pg_ctl -D "$t/db" -m fast stop >/dev/null; echo "took $(( $(date +%s) - s ))s"; rm -rf "$t"

script.say:
**Result**
- restored — /backups/pg/shop-2026-10-25.dump, 25 Oct 03:00, 412M

**Row counts**
- public.orders — 9,100 — last week 12,400 — down 27%: flagged
- public.customers — 3,215 — last week 3,190 — up 0.8%

**Took**
- 94s

## Report
- restored into a scratch database in one command and removed it; touched no live database
